findings.observed: Controller accepts either AC or battery at start, then only preserves that source. It never reads/checks low-power mode or current power settings. Comparing manifest powerSettings to first job accepts initial lowpower1 and cannot detect a job-internal setting change.
findings.required: Enforce the declared Battery-only/lowpower0 start; capture fixed settings and validate them during polling and at job end, failing the affected job/block on change.

findings.observed: Per-job cleanup records identity absence but does not require all captured identities absent before the next job. A browser process can outlive cleanup while port is free; later cleanup overwrites the earlier receipt and final-only check can then pass.
findings.required: Fail closed after each job if any captured owned identity remains or the owned port is not free; preserve each job cleanup receipt before launching the next job.
